quote: Why do you carry yesterday so heavily? When the morning sun demands nothing from you. We collect old sorrows like precious stones, polishing the edges of our own grief. But shadows fade when you turn around, and burdens only weigh what you allow. So why not drop the stone today? Freedom begins the moment you let go.
